manifest_ref.description: Reference or path to the Specification Manifest (manifest.json)

public_interface.description: Language-neutral public API contract enabling clean-room auditing before code inspection

target_module.description: Target module or source file name, e.g. 'mandelbrot_iteration.py'

name.description: Callable function or class entrypoint name
Parameter name; prefix variadic positional/keyword parameters with '*' or '**' (e.g. '*args', '**kwargs')

verification_obligations.description: Traceable verification obligations derived from SPEC-k manifest claims, drawn from Hughes's 4-predicate basis

spec_id.description: Traceability link to manifest specification claim, e.g., 'SPEC-1' or equation identifier

source_spec_id.description: Alias for spec_id traceability link, e.g., 'SPEC-1'

predicate_type.description: 'anchor' (pinned test vectors/boundary values), 'reference_model' (naive pseudo-oracle comparison), 'relational_law' (metamorphic/algebraic invariants), 'postcondition' (universal bounds and error checks)

formal_predicate.description: Relational expression or logic property, e.g., 'abs(z_next) > 2.0 ==> escaped'

tolerance.description: Optional per-obligation tolerance specification (e.g. 'exact' or numeric rtol)

inputs.description: Concrete sample inputs or strategy parameters

expected.description: Exact expected value, closed-form expression, or invariant condition

anchor_test_cases.description: Fast smoke test vectors for Stage 3 implementer smoke-testing

expected.description: Expected closed-form value or error expectation

symbol.description: Theoretical symbol, parameter, or state variable identifier

unit.description: Optional SI or dimensional unit tag matching manifest.json variables[*].unit

spec_id.description: Optional traceability link to SPEC-k claim in manifest.json

operation.description: Theoretical operation, formula, or algorithmic rule (e.g., 'Summation \sum_{i=1}^n x_i', 'State Transition')

precondition_assertions.description: Executable Python assertion statements for function preconditions

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions regarding conditioning, singularity, or domain limits

suggested_packages.description: Optional suggested runtime/scientific packages for @Engineer to pin in requirements.txt

upstream_modules.description: Optional seal-verified upstream specs/<spec_slug>/ packages imported as read-only Cleanroom dependencies

spec_slug.description: Directory slug under specs/ containing a sealed PROVENANCE.json

module.description: Verified Python module filename inside specs/<spec_slug>/

imported_symbols.description: Optional list of functions or classes imported from the upstream module
